abilities.name: Born Soldiers
abilities.legend: Regiments of numerous origins and tactical roles inculcate their soldiers from an early age with the legendary doctrines of the Tactica Imperium. Infantry train in close-range fire patterns intended to decimate enemy soldiers, whilst tank crews spend countless hours practising to bring down enemy armour and rampaging monstrosities.
abilities.description:
Each time a model in a Regiment unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES), that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Each time a model in a Squadron unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

abilities.name: Fire Zone Purge
abilities.legend: Key to this force’s mission is the swift purgation of local enemy forces through sudden deployment and focused firefights. As such, whether they hit the ground from a low-altitude drop or deploy from armoured transports, the soldiers of this formation are trained to find targets and start shooting the instant the foe is in sight.

abilities.name: Artillery Support
abilities.legend: Artillery barrages lay the ground for the assault to come.
abilities.description:
At the start of the battle round, select one of the following types of artillery support.
• Creeping Barrage: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit that is more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield: On a 5+, until the end of the battle round, that unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. The maximum number of units that can be shaken by this rule in each battle round depends on the battle size, as shown below.
• Incendiary Bombardment: Select a number of enemy units more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are scattered. While a unit is scattered, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.
• Smoke Shells: Select a number of units from your army. Until the end of the battle round, those units have the Stealth ability. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.

abilities.name: Armoured Fist
abilities.legend: Astra Militarum mechanised forces combine heavy armour with elite infantry. Reliant on speed and short-ranged firepower, the armoured spearhead hurtles through the enemy line and deploys its cargo of shock troops to cut the enemy down with volleys of lasgun fire.

abilities.name: Iron Tread
abilities.legend: The armoured spearhead of an Astra Militarum army group grinds relentlessly forward, ploughing through enemy infantry with arrogant disregard.

abilities.name: Masters of Camouflage
abilities.legend: Reconnaissance infantry use face paint, camo-pattern fatigues, ghillie suits and more to conceal themselves from the foe. Vehicles are camouflaged using netting and disruptive camo patterns, enabling them to blend into surrounding terrain. Suitably outfitted, recon forces need only rely upon stealth and concealment rather than heavy armour for protection.
abilities.description: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units (excluding TITANIC units) have Stealth.

abilities.name: Ruthless Discipline
abilities.legend: The officers of this company are wily, iron-willed veterans both respected and feared by the troops under their command. At their barked orders, even the weariest soldiers redouble their efforts.

Add 1 to the number of Orders each Astra Militarum Officer model from your army can issue, as stated on their datasheet.

abilities.name: Ceaseless Cannonade
abilities.legend: The heaviest Astra Militarum vehicles are adamantine behemoths whose armour is almost impenetrable. The crews of these colossal war engines need have no concern for the integrity of their vehicles, unleashing even the most violently destructive ordnance at point-blank range.
abilities.description:
Each time an Astra Militarum Titanic or Astra Militarum Squadron unit from your army is selected to shoot, models in that unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of that unit (including with Blast weapons), provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. When doing so, such models do not suffer the penalty to their Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units (excluding attacks made with Indirect Fire weapons).

KEYWORDS
In the Muster Armies step, you can select one or more ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC units from your army to gain the CHARACTER keyword.

Designer’s Note: This means that the selected units can be given Enhancements, and one of them can be selected as your WARLORD.

abilities.name: Squadron Command
abilities.legend: Officers in charge of motorised formations are as well versed in armoured combat as in infantry operations.

KEYWORDS
Astra Militarum Squadron units from your army have the ARMOURED SKIRMISHER keyword (excluding Artillery units and units containing one or more models with a Wounds characteristic of 13 or higher).

abilities.name: Absolutist Principles
abilities.legend: Commissars with experience overseeing auxiliary platoons display the ferocious strength of will and fearsome levels of scrutiny needed to ensure the most thick-skulled or rebelliously larcenous of soldiers – no matter what their size or shape – do their duty

abilities.name: Designated Targets
abilities.legend: A regiment’s resilient and often unconventional scouts are deployed to provide forward intelligence on enemy dispositions. With a combination of regimental issue scopes and guerrilla instincts hard-won through survival at the forefronts of war zones, they can draw massed firepower down on lurking threats.

datasheets.name: Leman Russ Commander
datasheets.legend: The venerable Leman Russ makes an excellent command tank. Many officers choose these reliable vehicles, broadcasting orders to other war engines and, when necessary, emerging from their cupola to bellow orders and provide a visible symbol of Imperial power.

abilities.name: Voice of Command
abilities.description:
If your Army Faction is ASTRA MILITARUM, Officer models with this ability can issue Orders. Each OFFICER’s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue in a battle round and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an Officer model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that Officer model to issue it to.

OFFICER models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a Transport or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.

abilities.name: Scouts 6"
abilities.description:
This ability always takes the form Scouts X". In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following:
• If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.
• If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (see below).
• If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.

SCOUT MOVE

MAXIMUM DISTANCE: The X" in Scouts X".

ELIGIBLE IF: It is the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, and your unit is wholly within your deployment zone.

EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).

AFTER MOVING: Your unit must be more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

Each OFFICER’s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue in a battle round and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an Officer model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that Officer model to issue it to.

OFFICER models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a Transport or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.

At the end of your opponent’s Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit that was set up or ended a move within 8" of this model, and one friendly Regiment unit within 6" of and visible to this model that has not made a Normal move or been targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem this phase. That REGIMENT unit can then either:
• Make a Normal move of up to D6".
• Shoot at that enemy unit, but only if it is an eligible target. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.
• Declare a charge. That REGIMENT unit must end that charge move engaged with the enemy unit you selected (note that even if this charge is successful, the charging unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn).

datasheets.legend: Veteran soldiers who have lived long enough to receive additional training in stealth, reconnaissance and ambush, Cadian Recon Squads are an asset to any regiment. stratagems.legend: An enemy who manages to pierce the Ogryns’ dense forms often succeeds only in attracting their attention and becoming the objects of a sudden and trampling rush.

stratagems.legend: The potency of armour and infantry is greatly enhanced when both work in close concert.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of any phase.

TARGET: One Regiment unit from your army and one Squadron unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.
stratagems.targetText: One Regiment unit from your army and one Squadron unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.

stratagems.name: FIELDS OF FIRE
stratagems.legend: Armour and infantry work in concert, forming overlapping fields of fire against which neither cover nor heavy armour can protect.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Regiment unit and one Squadron unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.targetText: One Regiment unit and one Squadron unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: INSPIRED COMMAND
stratagems.legend: The greatest officers make their voices heard at the critical moment, their orders swift and decisive.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.

stratagems.name: FLEXIBLE COMMAND
stratagems.legend: Some Astra Militarum officers have served with infantry and armour, and are equally adept at commanding either.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Any number of Astra Militarum Officer units from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to Regiment units and Squadron units.
stratagems.targetText: Any number of Astra Militarum Officer units from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to Regiment units and Squadron units.

stratagems.name: REINFORCEMENTS!
stratagems.legend: So numerous are the infantry of the Astra Militarum that fresh reserves can be called up at a moment’s notice.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One Infantry Regiment unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.

RESTRICTIONS: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.targetText: One Infantry Regiment unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effectText:
Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: TRIGGERED ALERTS
stratagems.legend: Alerted by proximity snares set up by recon teams, readied soldiers can evade their prowling foes to prepare new firing lines.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.

TARGET: That ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3"
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.targetText: That ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3"

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DETECTION
stratagems.legend: With a daring reconnaissance dangerously close to the hiding enemy, soldiers can provide more accurate reports of their location.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: While a visible enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that unit has +3" detection range.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effectText: While a visible enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that unit has +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: SUMP-SMOG SCREEN
stratagems.legend: Named for the density and reek of their concealing smoke, varied packs of foul chemicals are carried by elite scouts that can be ignited to foul the enemy’s aim.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase

TARGET: One friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit.

EFFECT: When an attack targets either your unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.
stratagems.whenText: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase
stratagems.targetText: One friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit.
stratagems.effectText: When an attack targets either your unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

stratagems.name: ADDITIONAL ARMOUR
stratagems.legend: Veteran soldiers know the value of additional protection, whether welded to vehicles or worn under flak armour.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetText: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectText: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: VETERAN SHARPSHOOTERS
stratagems.legend: Marksmanship is a skill that only increases with experience.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
stratagems.targetText: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: NO RETREAT!
stratagems.legend: Battle-hardened and zealous, the company’s grizzled elites will gladly give their lives to honour the Emperor.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order.

EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.
stratagems.targetText: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order.
stratagems.effectText: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.

stratagems.name: SNAP TO IT
stratagems.legend: Reading the flow of battle and reacting in accordance, this officer expects their barked orders to be followed post-haste.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of any phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit’s OFFICER model can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s OFFICER model can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.

stratagems.name: PURGING FIRE
stratagems.legend: Clear the area and defend your objectives. Take no prisoners.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.targetText: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: MORDIAN MINUTE
stratagems.legend: Named for the soldiers of Mordian, this rapid-fire drill requires exceptional accuracy and coordination, but renders even the humble lasgun highly lethal.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army affected by the First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! Order.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army affected by the First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! Order.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: BLAZING ADVANCE
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: By petitioning the machine spirits of their vehicles, tank crews push their armoured steeds beyond conventional limits.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Advances.

TARGET: That SQUADRON unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.targetText: That SQUADRON unit.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: FURIOUS CANNONADE
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: At close range, armoured vehicles open up with their full complement of weapons, dispensing the Emperor’s righteous wrath.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Squadron unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.targetText: One Squadron unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: FINAL HOUR
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even with flames licking through the interior of their vehicle, this crew refuse to abandon their positions, regardless of the risk to their lives.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One Squadron unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding Officer units).

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.
stratagems.targetText: One Squadron unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding Officer units).
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even in retreat, the armoured fist of the Astra Militarum keep their cannons firing.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That SQUADRON unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.targetText: That SQUADRON unit.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: CRASH THROUGH
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the grinding advance of an Astra Militarum armoured corps.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

stratagems.name: ABLATIVE PLATING
stratagems.type: Hammer of the Emperor – Wargear Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Crews routinely reinforce their vehicle's armour, adding ablative plating, track links, sandbags and other means to protect the hull.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: CLEAR AND SECURE
stratagems.legend: Mechanised charges rely upon shock, awe and speed to secure ground. Any enemies that block the path must be obliterated swiftly.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.targetText: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: SWIFT INTERCEPTION
stratagems.legend: Fast-moving armoured transports allow a commander to react quickly to enemy movements and intercept outflanking opponents.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One Transport unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TiTANic units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.

EFFECT: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.targetText: One Transport unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TiTANic units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
stratagems.effectText: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: HASTY EXTRACTION
stratagems.legend: Should the tide turn against them, mechanised forces swiftly re-embark their transports in order to reposition.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.

EFFECT: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an AsTRA Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effectText: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an AsTRA Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: RAPID DISPERSAL
stratagems.legend: Troops trained in mechanised combat disembark swiftly from their transport’s hatches, avoiding incoming fire and advancing on their objectives.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this phase.

EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Your INFANTRY unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: MOVE OUT
stratagems.legend: High command’s priorities have shifted. Swift embarkation and redeployment is required.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.

EFFECT: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an Astra Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
stratagems.targetText: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an Astra Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: VOX-RELAY
stratagems.legend: This armoured transport has been modified to house a tactical command suite and vox-relay, enabling embarked officers to give orders from relative safety.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One Infantry Officer unit from your army embarked within a Transport. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it is embarked within a TRANSPORT.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can issue Orders even though it is not on the battlefield, and it can issue Orders to Astra Militarum Transport units from your army [excluding TiTANic units) regardless of the distance to and from your unit’s TRANSPORT.
stratagems.targetText: One Infantry Officer unit from your army embarked within a Transport. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it is embarked within a TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, your unit can issue Orders even though it is not on the battlefield, and it can issue Orders to Astra Militarum Transport units from your army [excluding TiTANic units) regardless of the distance to and from your unit’s TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: SCOUTING OUTRIDERS
stratagems.legend: Sentinels and cavalry units use their speed and mobility to outflank the foe, ready to strike at the most opportune moment.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Mounted or Astra Militarum Walker unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Mounted or Astra Militarum Walker unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectText: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: CRACK SHOTS
stratagems.legend: Reconnaissance units are often comprised of experienced survivalists and hunters, many of whom are expert marksmen.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Platoon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.targetText: One Platoon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: DRAW THEM OUT
stratagems.legend: Light infantry utilise harassing fire to draw their enemies into position for an ambush.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One Platoon unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.targetText: One Platoon unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: COURAGEOUS DIVERSION
stratagems.legend: These soldiers scream blood-curdling battle cries as they rush forwards, emboldening their squadmates and causing the enemy to waver.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Infantry or Astra Militarum Mounted unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.whenText: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Infantry or Astra Militarum Mounted unit from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: SCRAMBLE FIELD
stratagems.legend: This unit is equipped with a scramble field generator, a device capable of disrupting teleportation beacons and other homing technology.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of your unit.
stratagems.whenText: Start of your opponent’s Reinforcements step.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of your unit.

stratagems.name: TANGLEFOOT GRENADES
stratagems.legend: Employed by skirmishers and recon troops, tanglefoot grenades ensnare advancing infantry, slowing their advance.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM GRENADES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.targetText: One ASTRA MILITARUM GRENADES unit from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: TRENCH FIGHTERS
stratagems.legend: Inured to the savage horrors of trench warfare, these warriors will fight until their last breath.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if it is a Regiment model. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if it is a Regiment model. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: CALLOUS SACRIFICE
stratagems.legend: All victory requires sacrifice. The destruction of the enemy must always take priority over the preservation of lives.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Platoon unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
stratagems.targetText: One Platoon unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

stratagems.name: OVER THE TOP
stratagems.legend: The whistle blows to signal the attack. Waves of infantry emerge from cover to advance upon the foe.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your Command phase.

TARGET: One Infantry Officer model from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when your model issues the Move! Move! Move! Order, it can issue that Order to any number of eligible friendly Infantry Regiment units, regardless of range to your model.
stratagems.targetText: One Infantry Officer model from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, when your model issues the Move! Move! Move! Order, it can issue that Order to any number of eligible friendly Infantry Regiment units, regardless of range to your model.

stratagems.name: FURIOUS FUSILLADE
stratagems.legend: Whilst accuracy has its benefits, sheer weight of fire is no less effective at bringing down the foe.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Platoon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit while targeting an enemy unit within half range.
stratagems.targetText: One Platoon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit while targeting an enemy unit within half range.

stratagems.name: FLARE BURST
stratagems.legend: As the infantry assault proceeds, flares are fired into the skies, illuminating opponents below.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit within 12", you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit within 12", you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: MINEFIELD
stratagems.legend: Sappers have laid down a network of mines across the battlefield. Should the enemy attempt an ill-advised assault, they will surely suffer for it.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One Platoon unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.whenText: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Platoon unit from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: ACCURACY UNDER PRESSURE
stratagems.legend: Only the most disciplined soldiers and vehicle crews can maintain accuracy in the deafening confusion of an armoured clash.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.targetText: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: ENGINE OF WRATH
stratagems.legend: An unstoppable engine of destruction, this super-heavy tank thunders forward, crushing enemies to bloody pulp beneath its steel treads.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Titanic unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 2, and each time a model in your unit fights, it can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Titanic unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 2, and each time a model in your unit fights, it can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE BEHEMOTH
stratagems.legend: Barricades, trenches, bunkers and ruins: these obstacles are ground to dust by the obdurate advance of Astra Militarum armour.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: IMPOSING ARRIVAL
stratagems.legend: The arrival of a super-heavy tank on the battlefield can swiftly turn the tide of the fight.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Titanic unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Set up your unit on the battlefield, wholly within 8" of the battlefield edge and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.whenText: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.
stratagems.targetText: One Astra Militarum Titanic unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effectText: Set up your unit on the battlefield, wholly within 8" of the battlefield edge and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: WITHERING FIREPOWER
stratagems.legend: Subjected to a thunderous volley of explosive shells and bullets, enemies begin to waver.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.targetText: That ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effectText: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.name: SHATTERING SALVO
stratagems.legend: Turrets and sponsons unleash a tempest of fury, toppling fortifications and leaving stunned and wounded enemies exposed to incoming fire.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum Titanic unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum Titanic unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.targetText: That ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effectText: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

enhancements.name: Bold Leadership
enhancements.legend: This officer’s aggressive command style sees them lead the advance personally, planting the regiment’s colours on seized objectives and leaving following troops to defend the ground they have gained.
enhancements.description: Infantry Officer model only. If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase, and the bearer’s unit (or any Transport it is embarked within) is within range of that objective marker, that objective marker remains under you control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

enhancements.name: Eager Advance
enhancements.legend: This officer relishes serving in the vanguard and seeks to take up a forward position to be closer to the foe when the firing begins.
enhancements.description: Infantry Officer model only. While the bearer is leading a Regiment unit, that unit has the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Calm Under Fire
enhancements.legend: In clipped tones, this officer issues clear and precise orders to the vehicles under their command - regardless of the bloodshed.
enhancements.description: Vehicle Officer model only. Once per turn, after the bearer issues an Order to a Squadron unit from your army, it can issue the same Order to another SQUADRON unit from your army.

enhancements.name: Battalion Commander
enhancements.legend: High-ranking officers of armoured regiments may operate super-heavy tanks as command vehicles, their orders blaring from hull-mounted laud hailers or crackling over internal vox-channels.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum Titanic Character model only. The bearer has the Voice of Command ability and the Officer keyword, and can issue up to 2 Orders to Astra Militarum Titanic and Squadron units.

enhancements.name: Death Mask of Ollanius
enhancements.legend: This mask depicts in obsidian and void-fired bronze the agonised visage of Saint Ollanius. Soldiers in the ancient artefacts presence are gifted the determination and endurance of the famous martyr himself.
enhancements.description: Officer model only. While the bearer’s unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, instead of changing it to 0.

enhancements.name: Exemplary Officer
enhancements.legend: Possessed of great initiative and authority, this officer marshals surrounding assets with great efficiency.
enhancements.description: Infantry Officer model only. Each time the bearer issues an Order to its own unit, you can select up to two other Platoon units within 3" of the bearer’s unit. That Order is also issued to each of those units.

enhancements.name: Abhuman Detail
enhancements.legend: Ogryns respond well to this Commissar’s stern discipline and are even known to accompany them as a personal bodyguard.
enhancements.description:
Commissar model only. Add the Ogryn keyword to the list of units this model can issue Orders too (as stated on its datasheet).

In the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to an Ogryn Squad or Bullgryn squad unit.

supportLeaderOverride.rawHtml: LEADER: BULLGRYN SQUAD, OGRYN SQUAD

enhancements.name: Sharp Eyes
enhancements.legend: These Ratlings’ naturally keen vision is supplemented with varied magnoculors, listening devices and other detection gear that mysteriously comes into their possession.
enhancements.description: RATLINGS unit only. When this unit is selected to shoot, enemy units have +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

enhancements.name: Bombast-class Vox-array
enhancements.legend: Carried by an officer’s comms specialist, this device is a precious example of an omni‑frequency master vox‑array manufactured on the long‑lost forge world of Urvax. It facilitates the rapid dissemination of orders throughout the entire strike force.
enhancements.description: MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER model only. When this model issues an Order, if this unit has the Master Vox wargear ability, this model can issue that Order to up to three different REGIMENT units, instead of only one.

enhancements.name: Long-Range Scout
enhancements.legend: Veteran pilots of Scout Sentinels have a reputation as insubordinate mavericks or taciturn loners, but their skill in manoeuvring their often-camouflaged walker unseen into hostile territory is second to none.
enhancements.description: SCOUT SENTINEL unit only. This unit has Infiltrators

enhancements.name: Guerrilla Honours
enhancements.legend: This officer is a specialist in covert warfare, their experience ensuring they know exactly when to redeploy their forces and close the jaws of their pre-prepared trap.
enhancements.description: Infantry Officer model only. After both players have deployed their armies, if the bearer is on the battlefield, select up to three other Astra Militarum Infantry units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Exemplar of Duty
enhancements.legend: The whine of hidden bionics, webs of ugly scars, or the rattle of abraded lungs with every barked order signals a grizzled veteran whose devotion to duty has seen them survive not only the enemy but also proximity to the most overly muscled soldiers.
enhancements.description: COMMISSAR model only. This model has Feel No Pain 4+.

supportLeaderOverride.rawHtml: LEADER: BULLGRYN SQUAD, OGRYN SQUAD

enhancements.name: Priority drop Beacon
enhancements.legend: Locked to the designator runes of this officer’s dropship and heavily warded against interference, this predeployed beacon ensures they and their elite soldiers land swiftly and on target.
enhancements.description: MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Recon Star
enhancements.legend: Those soldiers who have earned this commendation have earned their skills stealthily trekking through dangerous no man’s land far in advance of the main push, striking behind enemy lines on missions of sabotage, or laying flanking ambushes
enhancements.description: ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY PLATOON unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Scare Gas Grenades
enhancements.legend: Filled with powerful hallucinogens, these grenades overwhelm the senses of those who breathe their fumes, causing them to panic and flee their positions.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum Infantry model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 8" of the bearer’s unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units); that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Sacred Unguents
enhancements.legend: Regimental Tech-Priests bless the vehicles under their charge with holy prayer and sacred oils.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one Transport from your army (excluding Aircraft and Titanic units) within 3" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, each time that TRANSPORT makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Indomitable Steed
enhancements.legend: This officer goes to war in a favoured vehicle that - whether by fortune or apparent divine intervention - has survived dozens of battles despite suffering heavy damage on multiple occasions.
enhancements.description: Vehicle Officer model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

enhancements.name: Flash Grenades
enhancements.legend: These grenades emit loud bangs and bright flashes of light, disorienting defenders and allowing the officer and their bodyguard to press home their assault.
enhancements.description: Infantry Officer model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Aquilan Eye
enhancements.legend: This bionic lens contains a miniaturised auspex capable of detecting the slightest flaws in enemy defences.
enhancements.description:
Astra Militarum officer model only. Each time you select an Order for the bearer to issue, you can select the Order below:

Target Weak Spot (Order): Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Master Manoeuvrist
enhancements.legend: Academy training and battlefield experience have instilled in this officer a mastery of mobile warfare. At their barked orders, soldiers and armoured vehicles work in well-drilled unison.
enhancements.description: Infantry Officer model only. At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in that unit is within 3" of an Astra Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

enhancements.name: Drill Commander
enhancements.legend: This officer has spent countless hours putting their soldiers through ceaseless firing drills. In the heat of combat, the worth of this training reveals itself.
enhancements.description: Officer model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, if that unit Remained Stationary this turn, a Critical Hit is scored on a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

enhancements.name: Titan Killer
enhancements.legend: Seeking to add another kill marking to their war machine, this glory-hungry tank commander seeks out and engages only the heaviest enemy assets.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum Titanic Character model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, you can re-roll the Damage roll.

enhancements.name: Engine Speaker
enhancements.legend: Intimately attuned to the machine spirits of Astra Militarum vehicles, this Tech-Priest administers rites  and rituals, seeking to draw additional performance from engines.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer model only. Each time the bearer uses its Omnissiah’s Blessing ability, until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of the selected VEHICLE model.

enhancements.name: Legacy Sidearm
enhancements.legend: Handed down by a mentor, this officer’s pistol is an artificer-crafted example of its type, and is all the deadlier for it.
enhancements.description: Infantry Officer model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristics of the bearers Pistols.

enhancements.name: Grand Strategist
enhancements.legend: This commander can precisely anticipate the ebb and flow of war, their seemingly reactive tactics often prepared far in advance.
enhancements.description: Officer model only. In your Command phase, the bearer can issue one additional Order.

enhancements.name: Spec Ops Veteran
enhancements.legend: This veteran commando officer imparts their experience in clandestine warfare to the rank and file.
enhancements.description:
Astra Militarum Infantry officer model only. Each time you select an Order for the bearer to issue, you can select the Order below:

Move to the Shadows (Order): Each time a ranged attack targets this unit, until those attacks are resolved, models in this unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Smoke Grenades
enhancements.legend: Smokescreens provide cover for the infantry advance and enable troops to disembark safely.
enhancements.description: Infantry Officer model only. The bearer’s unit has the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability while the bearer’s unit is wholly within 3" of one or more friendly TRANSPORT models.

enhancements.name: Survival Gear
enhancements.legend: Whether equipped with climbing gear, machetes or snow shoes, this unit moves swiftly across inhospitable terrain to engage the enemy.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum Infantry model only. The bearer has the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Omnissian Unguents  (Aura)
enhancements.legend: Tech-Priests of the Adeptus Mechanicus bear to battle an array of sanctified oils and tinctures of protection with which to bless the Machine God’s divine works.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer model only. While a friendly Armoured Skirmisher unit is within 3" of the bearer, that unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Regimental Banner
enhancements.legend: A regimental banner flies from this command vehicle, its colours displaying the might of the Astra Militarum for all to see.
enhancements.description: Vehicle Officer model only. Add 3 to the bearer’s Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Tripwires
enhancements.legend: Carefully placed tripwires detonate booby traps as the enemy advance, the resulting explosions causing the foe to halt in their tracks.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum Infantry model only. Each time an enemy INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit ends a Normal, Advance, Charge or Fall Back move within 8" of the bearer’s unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is stunned. While a unit is stunned, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Laud Hailer
enhancements.legend: This device amplifies the bearer’s voice, enabling their orders to cut through the din of battle.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum officer model only. Each time you select a unit for this OFFICER model to issue an Order to, that unit can be within 12" instead of within 6".

enhancements.name: Veteran Crew
enhancements.legend: Drilled endlessly by the officer in command, the crew of this tank are crack shots who know how to make every shell count.
enhancements.description: Vehicle Officer model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Vanguard Honours
enhancements.legend: Decorated veteran officers know when and where to press home the assault, ensuring their squad disembarks in the optimum position.
enhancements.description: Infantry Officer model only. The bearer’s unit can disembark from a Transport after it has Advanced. If it does, it makes a shock disembark move (Core Rules, 18.07) for that disembarkation.

enhancements.name: Assault Hatches
enhancements.legend: Ramps and hatches slam down on all sides of this titanic vehicle, enabling infantry to surge forth and overwhelm the enemy.
enhancements.description: Astra Militarum Titanic Character Transport model only. Each time a unit disembarks from the bearer after it has made a Normal move, that unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.

enhancements.name: Grand Strategist
enhancements.legend: Able to see the broader strategic picture, this experienced officer deploys their assets sparingly and with practised precision.
enhancements.description: Officer model only. After both players have deployed their armies, if the bearer’s unit (or any Transport it is embarked within) is on the battlefield, select up to two units with the Regiment or Squadron keywords from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Reactive Command
enhancements.legend: A natural tactician, this officer responds to their opponent’s manoeuvres in swift and decisive fashion, never allowing the foe to dictate the battle.
enhancements.description: Officer model only. Each time an enemy unit is set up within 8" of the bearer’s unit, the bearer can issue one Order. This is not counted towards the number of Orders the bearer can issue in a battle round.

enhancements.name: Stalwart’s Honours
enhancements.legend: Such is this officer’s aura of confidence that the soldiers under their command march into battle heedless of incoming fire, trusting in that old adage of the faithful - the Emperor protects.
enhancements.description: Officer model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, when that unit is issued an Order, it is also affected by the Take Cover! Order.
